spatial_relationships.description: Organization of horses within physical space

Lying down on the sternum with legs tucked under

methods: Aggressive defense against predators or threatening horses

teaching.description: Transfer of essential knowledge and skills

general: Pawing through snow to access forage
winter.social: Closer physical proximity for warmth, especially in harsh conditions
